src: A creature of immensity mounts the upper eyeline and radiates Godlight. Haunches dusted with Spindle glitter support a creature-shape sketched to being by the sentient background radiation of this plane, and wide, banded wings are edged to soar on stellar winds. Finally, irisdual light churning under =pronouns.possessive= tx-glass skin is refracted to the metaspectrum of impossibility and spills out of body in cornu spirals.

Minarets of starburst ejecta from the proto-universe wheel about a zeropoint and blur in the iridescence of a nondeterministic God.

Marble eaters kneel in priestly concordance with the Great Machine, drawing levers and priming hydrants to steer and be steered by the Computed Will. A dais of crystal diodes gives a dashboard view to the churning of geocultures hundreds of thousands of light years away.

In high relief, folds and knots of sandy hued shapes crown the sapphire surface of the spherical model. The juxtaposition of scales, the proportion of sea to land, and the collective wisdom harnessed to devise such a thing make your head spin.
Flanged ursteel anchors secure the tapered ribbon of Gjaus to its low earth point.
A bubbled ribbon of carbon motes lathed to the thickness of paper combs against its anchoring mechanisms and disappears skyward to a tapered nothing.
A bubbled ribbon of carbon motes lathed to the thickness of paper combs against its anchoring mechanisms and disappears skyward to a tapered nothing.

The viewing frustum fills with a rainbow mosaic of stellar candles, softened by the isles of dust across their impossible gulfs, and winking in fusil motion. As a single vista, the breadth of it staggers the conscious mind, which races to reduce the innumerable pixels to whole and platonic forms.

Great shelves of ice melt and feed the sapphire seas, which lap the drifting honeycombs of basalt and lime. Up here, coastline patterns emerge from millions of flowing contours, each of which might harbor a clade of snails, or trees, or rice farmers.

An aura of airy fuzz swirls above the marble, peeling together and dissolving apart in unending seasons, searing sea winds cooling to zephyrous breezes, sequencing the life rhythms of a breathing world.
Gigantic fruiting bodies in rich, unearthly hues stick to sponge forks and burp spores. They flit curvewise toward the electrostatic of the Spindle tether and rain down as glitter.
Superellipses of flat, sundrunk conductors tessellate a braided strip that is curved to best catch sunlight and its reflected runoff.
A ribbon of bubbled agate bows northwise and plunges through the well of clouds, blurring with a shelf of slouching landmass below.
From the shadowed gloam of an understratum tunnel emerges a south-ran bridge across the empyrean, underlit by the sunbeaming oceans below.
Sheets on sheets of highly fibrous composite material are lathed out to a flat and buildable pleat for high orbit poleis.
Squared, fibrous composite rises northwise above the Sheva and offers an angled view from the high mesa to the lower shelves.
Beneath the sunning poleis on the surface, unmappable labyrinths of cavernous, hollowed-out fiberstuff seat chiliads of fossilized underculture.
Megastruts are peeled apart and gilded with ropes of frayed composite, all shattered by the violence of time and frozen in the airless vacuum.
Hyperconductive silver underlooms the low strata, bat-like, and beams signal to the churning duffs below.
Long lines of superconductive timber transsect the North Sheva and magnetically levitate movers to skybent stops.
The latching diamond achieves magnetic lock with the legs of a mover palaquin and concludes the ritual of going.
Latches are burst open and magnetic charge flows outwise; mover capture is no longer possible.

The Sheva-wise length of the Spindle tether is clasped in the locking mechanisms of the arrival chamber. Stabilizing pounders beat their gongs and smooth vibrative aberrations from the Shevas' geolocked orbit.

A shouldered arch and gate reify the flow from terrestrial tree and sand to star perch, and vice versa. In the orchard of passage, at the foot of the gate itself, great slabs of ancestral shale ring the vessels of ceremony.

A shouldered arch and gate reify the flow from terrestrial tree and sand to star perch, and vice versa. In the orchard of passage, at the foot of the gate itself, great slabs of ancestral shale ring the vessels of ceremony.
The sinnorot intersect at a middle point and, plied by their golden ecliptics in the Blue Shul, heave movers to and from the heart of the North Sheva.

The beldam district has had its dustcloud fins welded to the superstratum and mazed with labyrinthite to protect the hyperbrain. Inside that electromagnetic cage and quantum temple, the stirrings of the Great Siach spill from its nondeterministic core.
Muqarnas spill down the high dome that once roofed the navel of the thousand starfolk road. Now singing bells sound through the hippodrome with no creaturely answer.

The spire-garden of outworld lime fired in the exhaust of starships looms over the low dacha. O'er tiers of antipodal colonnades, pond lilies creep up bannisters and peek at themselves. This is a place of portals.

Slow-turning gears of star-won metal are curtained in sails and flank an abacus of continental measure. The oil burns to light the functional temple, which doubles as synagogue to the 72-Fold Peace and, too, engine of its dictates.
Tall spars of the light-shunting massy stuff were erected o'er starports across the local cluster; the ley lines were bent and new channels of fluidic culture wrought.
Great, void-poking piers are freckled with starship hangars and crosshatched by crumbling marble boulevards. The jeweled cosmos shines through quarter-sphere domes.
A cyclopean drum of divining liquid is yoked to the stratum for peering at the mythopoetic event stream of the bubbled kingdom.
For what purpose did the Eaters rear a fairy tale people and let them think their pennant flew over the whole of a crystal universe? If there was one, it is lost.
Motes of stardust rain through the canopy of enchantment and swirl on wind. They refract the bubbled light and slip into unseen colors, pattering trees of damp and softest leaf.
The skin of the sacred lake dampens the sorceral songs of the forest and mirrors the Great Moon, its sapphire seas and continents of ash shivering in watery projection.
The great capsule (overwall and world-skin) holds the kingdom in truth but not in appearance, inverting the relation of the kingdom and its king.

Muraled cisterns hold the great liquid biobanks that preserve chiliads of terrestrial plant life. The phytonic index so engraved both mirrors and predicts the movements of culture; marshdwellers creep up river to chase fertile soil, and then retreat to canyons when the carnivorous clades thrive.

The spiraling triangle finial portrays the flowing asterism that gave the star cluster its prominence. Alpha, Bet, and Dalet emerged from the galactic nucleus and flowered, coursed o'er the same ecliptic tracks of the Great Machine, and sent a minyan of petal-beings to pray/play a future coupling into existence.

The mysterious thought-form woke from a lost current of local sapiance and squat itself a spongey mangrowth in the ultraviolet baths of the surface. It's long since desiccated, the visceral mass time-viced into something more like paper pulp.

The parabolic mitt catches signal from the far breadths of the cosmos and blows it back through the sounding horn.
Terrestrial plants and otherwise thrive in the hothouse bubble, roots kneading through the fibrous strata, leaves peeking sunwise across the void.
Strange growths and other mutations afflict the exposed plantlife, the shattered vacuum glass admitting unfiltered sun, dust, and spore colonies.
Great earth mounds were terraced and planted with crops doctored to voidroot and drink the sun's full spectrum of light.
Triumphal warps and market domes trace the paved superstratum valley, where Eaters of the medina and beldam district engaged their circling rituals.
The cambered cottages of the shesh qanim sprouted in tufts as star traffic crowded the low medinas and Eaters urged to spend more time topside.

As cottages filled the shesh qanim, late topsiders and margin-filling starfolk established homes on the sheva, southwise of the bubble and hugging the paneled-curtained cliff of the northern continent.

The old and circumscribed poleis of the surface stratum were home to the Eater clans and guilds that spilled up Gjaus in the primal eon before the Covenate. Here they hauled their early starfreight and peered at the blue marble they hoisted themselves off of in raw wonder.

Before even the early Eaters peopled the low medina, when the ark was being prepped to seed the far skies with the terrestrial genome, the first poleis rose out of the entheopolitics and mythoprosaic controversies of Gjaus's construction. Somehow, they stand still.

Here rise the syncretic arcades of the great bazaar in starport's lee. The market jammed the profusions of sixty stars into its tented halls: billion-weave rugs, ox-carted macroprocessors, poisonous perfumes, and cold peaches.

The richest of starfolk gifts were kept in vaults of diamondized zetachrome and piped-in stasis field. The perspective from the mover gives no inkling on whether the ionization of time has weakened these spacetime palisades of the Old Bank.

The horn and its great honeycomb of mirrors farm the moist light from the furthest reaches of this dimension and its neighbors. With it, the Eaters peered at the first moments of universal birth, and then eons that preceded.

Machinic cages store raw force sipped from the slipstream and used to reshape local spacetime. Occasionally, amathematical fluctuations allow a pushton to escape and beam a sidewise galaxy right in the core.

Potential is polarized into a magenta hex mesh and keyed to every strata in the phasic spectrum. Objects are blocked without exception.

A droplet of thixotropic fluid is downpulled to a basin by centripetal force. In synchronization with its spouse-locks, the net effect stabilizes the North Sheva in geostationary orbit and simulates the ambient pressures of 1g.

Quartziferous panels rotate in sharp helices around a magnetic pole. Their mirrored faces reflect particles out of side dimensions and through the weakened pocket of interspace. A fraction of energy is captured.

The shape of the carved megalith electrifies a forgotten squadron of neurons in a crawlway of your mind, launching you into sudden intimacy with the deep past, somewhere on the cusp of first thought. Then an uncertainty obtains as to which direction on the braid of time you are remembering.
The holy colophon is held on triangular display and approached for ritual and idolatrous reflection in cycles of primes.
Star slag from the early age of the cosmos burns in hues of orchid and indigo.
Star slag from the early age of the cosmos burns in hues of leaf and malachite.
Azzurum was starsailed from an andromedan quarry, tempered with chrome, and carved to the ritual shape of the chiber to buttress the vault of heaven.
Melted sand from thirty sun-worlds was blown to topological improbability and capped with finials of starless gold.
Starfire ikons skip on a board of holographic bronze.

Rainbow photons finish the million-year marathon here at the low-wise pressures of emptiness.

Sand was abraded from un-stone at a pressure farm in orbit to a neutron star, crush-fired in starship exhaust, and molded into unbreakable lucent panes. They offer a view of the star-ribboned void while also protecting from it.

A matchlock beam traces the silhouettes of creatures recently impressed on leylines and scrambles the sampling to produce a true random result. Thousands of years and centillions of bits pass through a choke point of the holographic now, and then are evanesced into one.

A great curved and flanged length of metal replicates the layout of the Witch Court on its three-handed sculptor species's steaming earth. There and under a quincunx moon, rhapsodes of war are locked in ceremonial combat.
This weapon has multiple grips that change its weapon type.
Continents of texture over the vessel's surface are artifacts of the alien hand, where the clay was thrown in the hearth of a misty otherworld, before being stripped of its gravitational hair.
A spindle of air-chugging greenculm mounts an unseen topological space and shoots stardrunk chips into its crevices.
A crown of bright and dripping star leaves casts mesmerizing shadows across its roots.

Cultured patinae grow in whittled grooves across the doors of star bronze. Inset on joined halves is a gigantic jeweled sphere, with islands of agate on drifting seas of turquoise. The myriad ways of being are depicted on the panel margins in high relief: Eaters lift and lower chains to the star-ribboned sky, swallow stardust, and cartwheel ritual to the vaporous rim of existence.

The sound bow of gleaming star bronze was cast against the perfect mouth of a rotachthon and inset with a zetachrome clapper. When tolled, the sound wave shifts in juxtaposition with the listener's subjective experience, and the rituals of being and going are announced.

Light gleams off carved ornamental cisterns, well-shapes designed to keep liquid fresh and fluidic. The chrome ore they are wrought from was shunted toward an observer's frame and locked in color by a stasis engine.
A chute of superconductive timber is keyed to rhyme with adjacent leylines and furnish a frictionless glide.
Goldleaf digits of a nondeterministic number system are arrayed inside the circumference of an ecliptic mosaic.
A vase of starry rose gold floats above the ground and is buffeted by a bouquet of crystal stems. Taken all together, the pipework-of-art evokes a sunning swan.

Bursts of coral and treelife from the outer rim of worlds crawl up the palanquin's magnetized legs and toward its golden roof. Chimes ring at the ritual of going, and fruited smoke pours from its portals.
An exit reacquaints the mover with the artifice that is a still world.

A lens of glass has crusted over the smooth stone where the heat of sacred math burned the air then cooled in Q.E.D. Under that dermis and the meteoritic layer, an electric heart grinds on the starfield of magnets and blinks in geospatial submission.
Hotstar bronze cybernetically set on a layer of living mesoderm assumes a pleasing and space-filling tessellation.
A wide wooden sitter offers sufficient room for the cybernetically grown rump or a psychochemically shrunken pair or an ontologically crunched triple.

An arched sofa brings movers together via the blunted tyranny of here and now. The wooden seat, cut from tree-things on a Coven moon world, bears a notch of some form made by every sitter in its hundred chiliad history.
Bright sun-iron fused in the collision of neutron stars has been incised with rhombic smoking windows and fit over a crucible of burning seed.
A constellation of bells cast from the local cluster's different lustrous hardrocks gives sonic depth and range to the mover rituals.
Black grates kindled by the light of the jeweled cosmos are stamped in dust with the hoofprint signatures of six hundred worlds.
Broad panels of stardyed metal enclose the starship hangar and act as palimpsests to ten hundred alphabets.
Undulant sods finger the air thirstfully and secrete a wax meant to protect themselves from the poison flares of their far-flung dwarf sun.

The vine's spirals squeeze against the pressure of a hidden eigth dimension of space (which only activates outside the density of the strangefluid they're used to being submerged in). When this happens, their cross-spits of solid argon grouse at a frequency that cankers all known earth metals.
Fulcrete, metal, and foam bands protect against the vacuum of space and offer pleasing visual texture to the flat interior, which keeps the heart high on long hauls.

A wood-carved hollow in the geometric bulkhead is circled with blankets and curtained with patterned textiles. In the long void between stars, gently rocked by the juddering of the hedron engine, shipfolk attain tiers of peaceful sleep unknown to onworlders.

Planks of oak cut from the trees of a rainy beryl world are nailed into the bulkhead. Floor cushions at its base offer a plush and low view on the rainbow spines of codices, each a portal to a far-flung corner of the universe.

The self-plucked feathers of a mountain moa were stuffed into a velvet cushion thousands of years ago and sold at the bazaar of Samech some time after.
Rich, rain-fed oak was hewn and nailed at simple angles. The surface presents a grained canvas for the organization of thought in the quiet reaches of space.
A seat of rich, rainfed oak was crafted by a master chairmaker in a farworld hilltown and angled to provide the ideal blend of starview contemplation and downturned focus.

The glass lune exhibits spiraling arms and the endless sluices that course between them. Pinchers, sliders, whistlers, and dials array the bezel and provide navigation affordances across the manifold.

Diagnostics of ship and star belt down the glass lune and into data banks. An array of flips, swipes, and precision spheres flank the dashboard on curved panels and provide query affordances across the manifold.
A retractible hex panel is fit on oiled tracks.
The seat cushions are vinyl-cocooned in the hue of a frozen ocean spilling free from tidal heat. Control dials, sliders, and switches grid the flat-paneled armrest.

Seat foam is pressed with weird backprints, painted with a dozen blends of sweat, and balanced on a metal dais.
A stanchion of bronze or bronze-like is bent into the characteristic spiraling triangle of a neighboring cluster. Gold patina shrouds it in cryptic and poetic patterns.
Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed.

The magnetic torch smolders inside the hedron with the offgases of high fusion, and the chamber rattles with potential.
Across a field of vacuum glass and chrome diodes blink in hedronic sequence.
Vacuum-safe foamwood beams with the lingering scents of myrrh, star porcelain, and snow-powdered peaches.
A metal support pillar is nicked with the scars of freight scrapes, hedron shrapnel, plasma shells, and bunk beetle bites.
A triad of corded wires hang from a swivel, each headed by a six-way speaker. Static in different octaves pours into the soundscape.
Papyraceous crysteel tissue sways in soft waves and aerates the carousel interior. The enclosure gives the impression of being inside an island fish.
Sucker disks shooting out the wheel of Qv like moist hands clutch the papery gills of the carousel, and thick slimy water pools beneath them. The parasitic burden has the walls panting and wheezing.
A panel of tone bars at harmonic ratios shine in sculpted blue light. The space hums with the residual input schema of past flights.
Audiovisual depictions of the moisture manifold splash over the panel's holographic surface. A small and gentle null melody sounds from the underlight.
A perfect circle of mossbed parts in a sine wave and grants in/out access to opposing darknesses.
Spinning lunes at counter heights provide concentrative posture for a variety of body geometries.
Spinning lunes at counter heights provide concentrative posture for a variety of body geometries.
A flowing shoulder of outworld lime ends in a flat, object-bearing head. The stone-flute creature depicted grants an eyeless stare.
Rich, rain-fed oak was hewn to a curiosity cabinet with shelves of all sizes. The vaulted chest is now a hundred-world bazaar.

The piccoloed orb of cosmic heft houses a watergoo of starbrightness. The substanace streams against the glass, sea-like, in one moment and then clonks to the bottom the next. It gives off an air of subatomic malaise.
A terrarium is colonized by humidifying mosses and algae thriving in the darkling carousel. A single, tipped stem arcs out and offers a smoking puff from the life-rich soup.
Outworld moss clades form ribboned patterns concretizing their unknowable social dynamics. They hang in an orb from a ceiling clutch and in their starfarer landlords spark wonder.

The carousel respiratory system is embedded in a wider network of biomechanical feelstuffs. Some confluence of its nodes have decided to grow a stemlike twine that supports a pinkish, seeing eye. Diagnostics confirm that looking around calms the ship down.

A blinding network of homesuns flicker in parallactic motion. Their systems are joined in the manifold by trade routes, shifting sovereign borders, and the convergence of galactic clusters. Smaller ligatures denote the personal notes of a vast travelogue, turning the whole picture into a hyperdimensional narrative.

A special caste of greensmith peopled the lower medinas of crysteel blast furnaces, where they'd siphon the still-soft metaling and braid artisan batches with their own gloved hands. Adaptation to tidal heat meant they could not return to the surface to witness the employment of their creation, but moon-time rituals bestowed them a precognitive sense for what would become of it.

Sheets of manufactured gold carved to a citylike byzantium channel current with negative resistance. Vast archways of bright tracery buffer the computing core of the Ark, assimilating inbound electrons into the sparkwall and shielding the inner sanctum from electromagnetic disturbance.
Outworld wood of searing crimson forms the maze hedge and trellis  to an evergrowths.
Chromodynamic flowering over the packed dimensions of multi-spacetime is viewed through a uniprism. The coercion of a petal-pruned viewing angle produces something analogous to a computation.
A jellified torus provides the ideal topological surface for the slippage and glomming of tracked information.
Across a field of vacuum glass and zetachrome diodes blink in gyres.
Great epiphenomenal domains are invented, interpreted, and tokenized as language to relay the well-being of the nondeterministic core.
Laser heads trace the actuation of spiral galaxies and burn holograms onto platters of dark matter.
Gusts of crystallizing normality are forced out the exhaust vents to keep the computing cores free and phenomenologically pliable.
If a machine spins up and down a world in sufficient haste, there are qualia begot that can be sampled but cannot be modeled.
A switch aligns the particle scatter on the far circle and shines an incising light.
Scattered points arrange to recorded positions and bloom in the theater of light.

The bright countenance and mane of short quills on the young urshiib cut through even a canvas of fraying light. His shoulders are drawn back with fresh purpose, and his eyes pierce the foreground with a laser's precision.

A depiction coheres of the explosive energy of the universe bottled in a shielded bulb and pistoned into a vast and edged intelligence. From there the great machinic archons of the Eaters fissioned in their oracula and, with baetyls as fingers, lathed the waking world.

The gown floweth over small shoulders, and a sidewise veil gives glitching shape to a face tilted at the angle of anonymity. At last and freed from the lace of its cuff, a hand is moted like a sorcerous lamp, and shines in fairness.
A drape flows off his shoulder with mythoprosaic inevitability, and the digital dyad implies both sanative peace on earth and congruity with the vault of heaven.

A curtain of blue, magenta, and scarlet hangs over the sacred hold of moon-and-sun shade and hypernova gold (color specifications handed down directly from the machinic being who ensued from the entheos within). Raw amateriality is titrated out the container boundary and canaled in managed doses to processors that crack it in order to do the uncomputable: decide from nothing.

Oily skinstuff whorls in eddies of purgatory gray and hardens to diamond at the claws. The shedim were star-toted off their god moon, bargained in one-hundred-year rituals to the machinic archons, and kept as pets. Once history lengthened down the dark well of the sultanate, they were poached to extinction for the milk of their precious irises.
Castle-dwelling wood artisans mimic the forest architecture of gnomes and create a hutch for their tales of outer spheres.
Liedowners at the trailhead of the dreaming dale get lost in the puzzle of marquetry and melt into the seafoam soft.

Wood artisans spend their whole life in intimate colloquy with a single tree. Upon their later years, when the rhythms of the Great Moon occupy a larger and larger share of their thoughts, they finally master the art of steam and bend heartwood to their wills.
No clothespress or cabinet is finished by the sunclock without a secret drawer, where children might keep their fey gifts and find them once more on the night of their death projection.
The mindful curvature of the wizarding surface masquerades as the Worldskin for learning minds who wish to trace the arc of sorcery.
Fairy moss powders the column and renders it damp with rainbow dew. Inside the shade, fey Magicks course in spheric everness.
When a song of power roars out the moted forest and slides up Worldskin, the sidewise veil shields the sorceress's ears and eyes.

Microscopic needlework on the sleeve encodes the entire history of the crystal sphere and Great Moon, at least from the fey perspective. In the well of kingdom and castle, the embroidered texture returns the pressure of a gloved hand locked in dance at the masquerade ball.
Raw astrocalcite fused in starship exhaust retains the bio geometries and colorful hues of shelled life. Eventually it will be pressurized and polished down to its masonry form.

Metal cribbed from the blackened nozzle of a starship was melted down by the Exhaustiers' Guild and cast to a monumental scaffold. The silhouettes of fried voidfauna are still visible on the burnished veneer.

Metal cribbed from the blackened nozzle of a starship was melted down by the Exhaustiers' Guild and cast to a monumental scaffold. The silhouettes of fried voidfauna are still visible on the burnished veneer.

Hyperdimensional scum glistens on the projection disc from when it was doused in the soapy film of interspacetime. The disc is silent now, sundered from its transcendental entanglements, its base offering a shadewall for moss to prosper on.

The stair, stage, and loop gate are cast in marble relief to their surroundings by hyperdimensional filament. The holograph vista of anotherworld temple is evanesced, and instead local lilies fill the frame.

Little decapods of chrome shell traveled the stars as hedron engine parasites, drinking torch runoff and nibbling through conductive line. Now they muse about their retirement garden, having been shot through the nozzle of a decomissioned ship and surfed to the scrapyard.
Five verdurous lobes fall off a star-pointed flower the color of burning exhaust. They float in circles, driven by rhizomatic impulse.
Sharp shoots of outworld crimson lust stab the air from their earthwise glove. When a puff of artificial wind fans them out, they sparkle and hiss.
Furry shrinewort grows over a ring of dead plant stems and drinks in the temple shade.

From the camber of the tree's twigs and trunk you infer a stellar arrangement of its homeplace too geometrically complex for natural starbirth. =pronouns.Possessive= ribbons throw the light like glass and dance on the stale air, strange pennants of a civilization shorn of familiarity. Here at the edge of =pronouns.possessive= foreign pond, the visitor being root-sips cool water in confounding performance.
Tombed shells peep out from under the inverted loop of lime, carved in rumination of parabolic life.
A lens of glass has crusted over the smooth stone, and its kinetic fins have been shorn off at the poles.
Spiral-lathed corner pieces of brass secure the bottomside of an old wooden trunk. In the style of its molluskan artisans, the top is left metalless and bare of insignia.
A loop on the pelagic neck was twirled to fit large hands of lime. The vessel smells of wine and myrrh.
Thumb smushes on the flared handles and neck show where the potter rushed to spin clay and fire the next order. But the edges of practicality are softened by a slow and berry rich glaze.
Dyed rush and palm fronds were pulled to a westwise weave for storeroom preservation. Its offshoot strands are stained dark apple red.
A pillow dome of goat hair stuffing grants the low and sunwise angles of repose.

A great sawed plank of oval-figured wood had been raised on legs and made the feasting board for a whilom king. Then an axe of dispute split it to pieces, and those children were carried off and shaved smooth to supply flatness again.
Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of scrumptious food. Its high awning is painted with the honeys and jams of the new season.
A burning Y of dried wood and cupped iron light the domiciles.
